header: What onboarding leads say after their first quarter
subheadline: Teams move to Brightpath to stop losing weeks between the signed contract and the customer's first working day. Three months in, the number they quote back to us is almost always the same one: time to go-live.
quote: We were handing accounts over in a spreadsheet nobody trusted. Our first quarter on Brightpath cut the median go-live from 38 days to 16, and I stopped spending every Monday reconstructing where each account actually stood.
author_role: Head of Customer Onboarding, Northwind Co.
